headers.//: unsafe-none, not same-origin-allow-popups. MSAL returns its token through window.opener; when the sign-in popup navigates back to this origin, COOP is re-evaluated and can sever that reference, so the sign-in never completes and MSAL is left with a stuck interaction_in_progress flag. Setting COOP here broke Outlook sending on 2026-08-09 (493fb4a) after it had been working. Do not tighten this without testing a real Outlook send.
